title: Oakland, morning: 30 % of vehicles are learned AVs
blurb: One shared PPO policy, trained with the barrier function as its teacher, drives every blue car among calibrated human drivers, pedestrians, cyclists, buses and vans. The band ahead of each AV is its barrier.

title: Oakland: AVs plan in a latent world model, under a barrier function
blurb: Every blue car searches 32 imagined 2.4 s futures each 0.2 s and drives the best, with a control barrier function on top; humans x5 riskier, cyclists in the lanes.

title: Oakland, stress test: risky humans, breakdowns, rush-hour demand
blurb: Human risk amplified ~100x (red runners, drivers who do not look, distraction) plus frequent breakdowns: the corner cases an AV must survive, compressed into five minutes. Rule-based AVs under the barrier function.

title: Squirrel Hill: half of the vehicles are learned AVs
blurb: A neighbourhood the policy never trained in: Forbes, Murray and the residential grid. Barrier function on.
